description: D-389 Phase 1 + D-411 S1 + D-434 (Ω-2.6) — the Intent spine with the debugging door: durable vault objects, the canonical writer path, replayable traces, the principal-owned lexicon, and the leakage audit.

contract.doc: D-434: the replayable derivation trace (normalize → parse → lexicon → disambiguate → resolve), resolverDigest-pinned, lexicon state cited per hit.
D-434: localize the change between the stored trace and a fresh resolution; refuses INTENT_TRACE_UNAVAILABLE when no stored trace exists.
D-434: principal-authored lexicon entry (alias/pattern/default/disambiguation-rule); realizations refused with INTENT_LEXICON_AUTO_APPLY_REFUSED.
D-434: the append-only revocation tombstone; revocation reverts the lexicon digest exactly.
D-434: a badged realization proposes; the proposal waits for a person (30d expiry).
D-434: the principal's one-time acceptance ceremony citing proposalRef.
D-434: the standing leakage audit — replay battery (INTENT_RESOLUTION_NONDETERMINISTIC tripwire) + static no-realization-in-walk provenance scan.

capabilities.justification: Phase 1: vault persistence for intent/intent-plan, resolution delegated to director, every step gated by law + single-use attenuated delegation (§3.2).
